title: Trigger a Jenkins scan when a PR head has no krn/gate check run
body:
Outcome: when deliver finds no krn/gate check run for the exact PR head after a bounded grace period, it triggers a Jenkins branch-source scan (lead permission) instead of waiting until its wait times out, and prints that it did.
Evidence 2026-11-06: PR #238 head ff6f460 pushed during the CI rollback had no krn/gate until Jenkins indexed it later (PR-238 build #1 at 07:14).
Proof: a deliver/gate-wait test with no check run for the head past the grace period issues exactly one scan request to the captured endpoint and keeps waiting; with a check run present it issues none.
Operator 2026-11-06: stop choking on gates.
